propositions: AC checklist items with operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, merge-gate, store-surgery, recorded-attestation) must be tagged [operator-attested] or the lint flags them as advisory coaching.
The lexicon lint extends p6_ac_quality as advisory, never blocks, and preserves DET_CHECKS at exactly 9 entries and CANONICAL_DET unchanged.
The tag matcher _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE is single-sourced in det_operator_attested and imported by workflow_ops so the plan-time lint and completion-verifier agree on tagged status.
The deterministic self-gate eval over the frozen historical AC corpus (3091 items, 31 pre-tagged) achieved ≥70% precision on ≥50-item sample, ≤5% flag rate, and both known cases (115b, 8c4f) fire.
The eval commit is a git ancestor of the activation commit, proving the eval result was pre-registered before the lint was wired into p6_ac_quality.
Unit tests verify known cases fire on untagged historical text, already-tagged items do not fire, and the regex is shared between det_operator_attested and workflow_ops.
